title.rendered: STREAMS OF JOY DEVOTIONAL- NO NEGATIVITY

content.rendered: “And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,” (Luke 8: 43)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.The woman with the issue of blood spent all she had on her issue of blood. She had resources before her issue of blood began. In order to counter the issue of blood, she began to give what she had; the more she gave to the ‘issue of blood’ situation, the more the ‘issue of blood’ situation swallowed what she had. A negative situation swallowed all that she had.Friend, I pray for you: any negative situation that wants to swallow what you have, I command it to break by the fire of God. Every satanic situation that wants to swallow your resources, may the fire of God consume it right away; every health challenge that the enemy has afflicted you with in order to impoverish you, I command the siege of the enemy to be broken; every conflict that is draining your resources, I command it to end now.The woman with the issue of blood could have been wealthy; she had what was spent on a twelve year old challenge; such resources could have been used to make life good and cozy, but alas, she spent all in order to redeem a bad situation. Hear me as I hear the Lord: your blessings will not be used to service negativity; your resources will not be channeled towards troubles.No more shall the negative situations of life swallow the good things that you have; no more shall you use your resources to service a negative situation; no more shall the tears that could have been released in worship to God be released in pain and regret; no more shall resources that should help you become food for the enemy; no longer shall your harvest be swallowed by negativity; your resources will not service negativity.The siege of the enemy on your resources, is broken. No more shall your resources feed the enemy/negativity.Isaiah 62: 8 says: “The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:”Declare With Me: No negativity will swallow my resources; my resources will not service negativity, in Jesus’ name!Follow on Instagram @jerry_ezeFollow on Twitter @jerrystreams
